div.head: Hn 70.19
div.ab: Et nullus heredipete suo propinquo uel extraneo (periculosa sane custodia!) committatur.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 589 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: vgl. Glanvilla VII 11: Nunquam custodia . . alicui remaneat [qui . . .] uelit aliquod ius in ipsa hereditate clamare; vgl. CHn cor. 4, 1. Die Très anc. cout. Norm. I 11 fragt: Orphanus heres, quis eum custodiet? Non mater, consanguinei, ne hereditatem cupientes opprimerent innocentem, sondern dominus terre; ähnlich Französisches Recht bei Beaune Introd. du droit coutum. 314

cf. Glanvilla VII 11: Nunquam custodia . . alicui remaneat [qui . . .] uelit aliquod ius in ipsa hereditate clamare; cf. CHn cor. 4, 1. The Très anc. cout. Norm.
